info.title: aurorachat for Wii U
info.author: Unitendo
info.details:
A chatting application originally for the Nintendo 3DS and 2DS systems, now on Wii U.

To use the app, create an account or log in to an existing one.
Users can send and receive real-time messages online. All messages are moderated, and users are expected to follow the rules. The Code of Conduct is available in the GitHub repository.

changelog:
v7.1
Changelog

- Added MOTD to the main menu. It is refreshed every time the user enters the main menu.
- Chat, rules and MOTD will be shown on the GamePad. The GamePad only shows the latest chat messages. You can use this to, for example, view message history on the TV while also keeping up to date with the most recent messages on the GamePad.
- Added a log out option in the settings menu.
- For privacy reasons, the account.dat file will now be removed when the user exits the app with Auto-Login disabled.
- Improved performance of the app by caching all text on screen.
- Chat, rules and MOTD is scrollable with the right analog stick. Use both analog sticks to scroll twice as fast as before.
- hugh is now listed in the credits for their contributions regarding the AuroraChat app icon and banner!
- The B button can now be used to exit from the settings menu.
- The app will now scroll to the bottom of the message history when opening chat, even with Auto-Scroll disabled.
- Auto-Scroll will now only scroll when the user is at, or below the bottom of the message history.
- Fixed the settings ON/OFF state not being shown on the GamePad.
- Fixed the Discord avatar not being shown when a message is sent with the Discord bridge.
- Fixed Auto-Scroll and line wrapping when TV was set to 720p and below.
- Improved certain parts of UI menus.

v7.0
Changelog

- Moved to the V7 server.
- Change rooms with the Y button. You can also DM users with this feature.
- Added new UI menus and modified preexisting UI menus. The main menu contains chat, rules, settings, and credits.
- Auto login can now be disabled on startup.
- Auto scroll can be toggled in settings.
- Server rules will be shown when logging in for the first time. Rules can also be viewed from the main menu.

v0.6.03
Changelog:
- The client is now compatible with the aurorachat v0.6 server.
- Redesigned the GUI to match the 3DS client.
- Added auto-login. The account data is stored in SD:/wiiu/apps/aurorachatforWiiU/account.dat. The data is NOT encrypted. Please don't share it with anyone!
- Avatars will be shown to the left of a message. They indicate the platform the message was sent from (aurorachat or Discord), and if it's a system message.
- The position and scale of the GUI is now based on the TV resolution. You can now use aurorachat for Wii U with the TV in 720p and even 480p resolution!
- Added auto-scrolling. The chat will automatically scroll when a message is sent.

v0.5.3
This release brings new formatting to the versioning to coincide with the 3DS client (v0.5.3 instead of v0.0.5.3). It was supposed to be like this in the previous release but I messed up the tag.

 What's new
- Added a reconnect button when the user disconnects from the TCP server.- The "Send" button will be replaced when this happens.
- Adjusted the last rules page.
- Fixed the buttons being clickable when the rules pages were shown, even if they were hidden.
- Previously you could Sign Up/Sign In with an empty username and/or password, the process would fail but it would say that the account was banned. It will now tell you beforehand that they are empty.

v0.0.5.2
This release brings new formatting to the versioning to coincide with the 3DS client (v0.5.2 instead of v0.0.5.2).

 What's new
- Fixed several issues that caused the login to fail.- If you still have issues signing up or logging in, it should now display more information regarding why it failed.
- Chat is now scrollable with the D-PAD.
- Added themes from aurorachat on 3DS.- You can also reverse the themes, swapping the colors with the TV and GamePad.
- You can now view the rules by pressing the Y button when chatting.[^1]- There's also a QR Code for the Unitendo Discord server on the last page.
- Just like the 3DS and Wii, the Wii U now sends a tag showing the console you are on.
